record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Song<WH07892> <FI>or<Fi> Psalm<WH04210> of Asaph<WH0623>.<Fo><Fo> Keep not thou silence<WH01824>, O God<WH0430>: hold not thy peace<WH02790><WTH8799>, and be not still<WH08252><WTH8799>, O God<WH0410>. <RF>of Asaph: or, for Asaph<Rf>

They have taken crafty<WH06191><WTH8686> counsel<WH05475> against thy people<WH05971>, and consulted<WH03289><WTH8691> against thy hidden ones<WH06845><WTH8803>.

They have said<WH0559><WTH8804>, Come<WH03212><WTH8798>, and let us cut them off<WH03582><WTH8686> from <FI>being<Fi> a nation<WH01471>; that the name<WH08034> of Israel<WH03478> may be no more in remembrance<WH02142><WTH8735>.
For they have consulted<WH03289><WTH8738> together<WH03162> with one consent<WH03820>: they are<WH03772><WTH8799> confederate<WH01285> against thee: <RF>consent: Heb. heart<Rf>
The tabernacles<WH0168> of Edom<WH0123>, and the Ishmaelites<WH03459>; of Moab<WH04124>, and the Hagarenes<WH01905>;
Gebal<WH01381>, and Ammon<WH05983>, and Amalek<WH06002>; the Philistines<WH06429> with the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of Tyre<WH06865>;
Assur<WH0804> also is joined<WH03867><WTH8738> with them: they have holpen<WH02220> the children<WH01121> of Lot<WH03876>. Selah<WH05542>. <RF>holpen: Heb. been an arm to<Rf><CM>
Do<WH06213><WTH8798> unto them as <FI>unto<Fi> the Midianites<WH04080>; as <FI>to<Fi> Sisera<WH05516>, as <FI>to<Fi> Jabin<WH02985>, at the brook<WH05158> of Kison<WH07028>:
<FI> Which<Fi> perished<WH08045><WTH8738> at Endor<WH05874>: they became <FI>as<Fi> dung<WH01828> for the earth<WH0127>.
Make<WH07896><WTH8798> their nobles<WH05081> like Oreb<WH06159>, and like Zeeb<WH02062>: yea, all their princes<WH05257> as Zebah<WH02078>, and as Zalmunna<WH06759>:
Who said<WH0559><WTH8804>, Let us take to ourselves the houses<WH04999> of God<WH0430> in possession<WH03423><WTH8799>.
O my God<WH0430>, make<WH07896><WTH8798> them like a wheel<WH01534>; as the stubble<WH07179> before<WH06440> the wind<WH07307>.
As the fire<WH0784> burneth<WH01197><WTH8799> a wood<WH03293>, and as the flame<WH03852> setteth<WH03857><WH00> the mountains<WH02022> on fire<WH03857><WTH8762>;
So persecute<WH07291><WTH8799> them with thy tempest<WH05591>, and make them afraid<WH0926><WTH8762> with thy storm<WH05492>.
Fill<WH04390><WTH8761> their faces<WH06440> with shame<WH07036>; that they may seek<WH01245><WTH8762> thy name<WH08034>, O LORD<WH03068>.
Let them be confounded<WH0954><WTH8799> and troubled<WH0926><WTH8735> for ever<WH05703>; yea, let them be put to shame<WH02659><WTH8799>, and perish<WH06><WTH8799>:
That <FI>men<Fi> may know<WH03045><WTH8799> that thou, whose name<WH08034> alone <FI>is<Fi> JEHOVAH<WH03068>, <FI>art<Fi> the most high<WH05945> over all the earth<WH0776>.<CM>
